author: reek
body: read-text is the handler-dispatched read of the FileSystem layer, and a handler must not be a way around a scope. This opening grants itself FileSystem.Read under "/config/" and then asks read-text for /etc/passwd. The scope check keys on the operation's name before any handler is consulted, so the refusal lands at compile time exactly as it does for the builtin-backed file-exists -- if this ever compiles, scoping an effect the layer serves means nothing.
